title: The Geometry of LLM Quantization: GPTQ as Babai’s Nearest Plane Algorithm
institutions: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

kingwen.integration_note: Babai nearest-plane interpretation gives worst-case layer-wise error bound under no-clipping; maps to King Wen no-roll determinism and bounded emotional vector propagation.

megatron.integration_note: Hessian-factor lattice basis view supports activation-aware quantization order heuristics for Megatron-trained checkpoints.

openjarvis.integration_note: PAA alpha fusion is already implemented as spectral soup lambda mixture; this paper provides the geometric justification for no-clip scoring and min-pivot order selection.

core_claims: GPTQ back-to-front is mathematically identical to Babai's nearest plane algorithm on a lattice defined by the Hessian matrix
No-clipping quantization inherits a tight worst-case error bound: ||error||^2 <= 1/4 * sum ||a_tilde_j||^2
Min-pivot order minimizes tr(D) of the LDL decomposition and consistently reduces the theoretical bound vs act-order
Additional GPTQ-style refinement after Babai projection is algebraically redundant
Practical no-clipping methods SSQR and HPTQ outperform clipped GPTQ; HPTQ 3.125-bit is Pareto optimal

sovereign_mapping.lattice_basis: activation Hessian factor X = X^{1/2} maps to King Wen phase-basis transform
sovereign_mapping.target_vector_y: weight vector wi in activation space maps to emotional_input-seeded resolved vector
sovereign_mapping.babai_projection: consult consensus across 64 expanded hex states as nearest-plane projection onto hex lattice
sovereign_mapping.error_bound: porosity + phase temporal variance as bounded deviation from optimal collapsed state
sovereign_mapping.min_pivot: select dominant hex by smallest diagonal energy first; already implemented in broadcast selection
sovereign_mapping.no_clipping: save-string V2.1 24-token pellets use exact integer fields; no semantic clipping in serialization
